onboarding.title: NoRing
onboarding.subtitle: Block unwanted calls with custom rules

android.heading: Set as Call Screener
android.body: NoRing needs to be your default call screener to filter calls in real time. Tap Enable and select NoRing in the next screen.

ios.heading: Enable Call Blocking
ios.body: Open iOS Settings and turn on NoRing under Phone → Call Blocking & Identification.
ios.pending: Waiting for you to enable NoRing in Settings…
